notes: Fixed effects showing their name and description but not their rolled number (e.g. "Assassinate +" instead of "Assassinate +5"). Most equipment effects resolve through a shared template that never carries the number — only a live examine of that specific item does — so an item whose examine hadn't been (fully) picked up yet would silently show number-shaped text with the number missing. The scan now detects this and includes those items in the "hover this item, then scan again" reminder instead of treating them as done.
